coverage_assessment: Nonexhaustive first-pass open-web research: 10 batched search invocations, 40 query strings and 292 ordered result headers. Search coverage included Danish and English date, campaign, sector and follow-up terms; pooled results do not establish per-term partitions or absence. Five day-level candidates remain for coordinator review: two proposed includes, two pending evidence and one pending state target. Source metadata records three opened cards: 1 current-unit body opens and 2 prior-unit-only consultations, plus 15 search-only cards. Local/regional archives, the official baseline and detailed coding procedure remain unavailable.
